sadness noun

also sorrow, unhappiness, gloom

classical

Sall. Cat. 31.1; Caes. BG 1.32 (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 157, 373
Andresian p. 36

trīstitia, trīstitiae f.

noun, first declension

Lewis & Short leaves the first vowel unmarked; the lexicon writes it long, as in trīstis (see sad).

Other words

  • maestitia, maestitiae f. — sorrow, gloom

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.146; Cic. Fin. 1.43 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 373

    Sorrow that shows in the face, dejection.

Examples

  • ex summā laetitiā atque lasciviā repente omnēs trīstitia invāsit

    after the greatest joy and high spirits, sadness suddenly seized them allSall. Cat. 31.1

See also sad, happiness.
